News

  • Getting bored by ordinary number seeds? You can now customize the seed generation on both the Seed Map and Seed Finder to find seeds that start the way you want, find anomalous seeds with repeating features, and more! Nov 10, 2026
  • You can now draw custom areas on the map, give them a label and color, and inspect their size. There's also a ruler, so you can measure the distance of a route. Nov 1, 2026
  • Some usability changes: The page is now wider on desktops, and mobile gets bigger text and buttons. Text fields on iOS should no longer zoom in when tapped. Also, optimized the layout on all devices to allow for larger maps. Let me know if something looks off! Oct 22, 2026
  • Added Lava Surface Pools and cave-biome-specific icons for Cheese Caves. Also, Fossils and Dungeon spawner types are more accurate now. Oct 11, 2026
  • Ice Caves are now available for Java Snapshots as well. Also, improved Lava Pool accuracy, and added shareable links, longer searches and biome patch conditions to Seed Finder. Oct 6, 2026
  • Added experimental Ice Caves support for Bedrock Preview versions. Oct 1, 2026
  • Chunk Base now keeps track of your seeds! Recover a seed you lost by spamming Random, bookmark and name the ones you like, and see your markers and completed locations in one place. Find it under the new "Seeds..." button next to Random. Sep 29, 2026
  • Wilderness Bound is live on Chunk Base with support for Abandoned Camps and Dappled Forest! Have fun exploring, however you like :) Sep 15, 2026
  • More accuracy updates for Bedrock temples, bastions, spawn, and End Cities/Ships for both Editions. You can now also adjust the grid lines to match Minecraft maps. Sep 8, 2026
  • Recent updates: Ruined Portal improvements (coordinates and giant type), improved accuracy for a lot of features (esp. Bedrock and Dungeons), updated Abandoned Camps, Biome Village icons, accuracy hints in popups, and performance improvements. Aug 25, 2026
  • Chunk Base now has a new Seed Finder app! It works like the map search, with conditions for biomes and structures. Seeds can be previewed right on the page. Hope that takes some pressure off the random button :) Let me know what you think! Jul 31, 2026
  • Excited to share a new search feature I've been working on. You can use it to quickly find and highlight structures and subtypes, clusters, biome patches, and create your own filters. Let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions! Jul 7, 2026
Stay up to date and join the discussion: Follow @chunkbase on Twitter!
